samples.summary: New exported helper `decimalsInValue` has no direct unit test; odd numeric strings (exponent form, trailing dot) untested
samples.evidence: `decimalsInValue` is added and exported in format.ts:92 and is the basis for every inference in `changeDecimals`, but no test calls it. I grepped `decimalsInValue` across packages/sheets (only src hits: format.ts, sheet.ts) and opened packages/sheets/test/model/format.test.ts's neighbours via the test glob; decimals.test.ts only exercises it indirectly with plain values like '12', '12.5', '1.2345'. Behaviours nothing covers: '1.5e3' yields 3 (the string after the dot is '5e3'), '12.' yields 0, '-0.50' yields 2, and a whitespace/percent-suffixed stored value. Those are exactly the inputs where an off value silently makes increase/decrease non-reversible.

samples.summary: New exported `omitStyleKeys` has no test for its documented undefined-vs-empty-object contract
samples.evidence: omitStyleKeys is added at range-styles.ts:64 with a load-bearing contract (return undefined when the style carries none of the keys, an empty object when all keys were removed — callers in sheet.ts use the undefined return to skip writes and the emptiness to drop patches). Grep for `omitStyleKeys` finds only src usages; packages/sheets/test/model/range-styles.test.ts (the natural home, not touched by this diff) has no case for it. The empty-object branch is only reached indirectly by 'should drop cell-level decimal keys and the empty cell with them', and the undefined branch (skip a redundant write) is never asserted at all.

samples.summary: `selectionRendersAt`'s skip branch for text/empty cells is untested: a decrease over a text-only selection is silently a no-op
samples.evidence: selectionRendersAt continues past cells failing `isNaN(Number(value))`, so a selection containing only text returns true and `changeDecimals(-1)` returns without writing anything. decimals.test.ts covers empty cells ('should not write a style when there are no decimals to drop') and numeric mixes, but no test puts a text value ('abc') in the selection — neither for the no-op path nor for the mixed text+decimal case where the write must still happen. Nothing in the suite pins whether text cells count as 'nothing to drop'.
searchedFor: grep for setData with non-numeric strings in test/sheet/decimals.test.ts

samples.summary: No test for a range-style patch that overlaps the selection without being contained by it (match-but-not-owned refusal)
samples.evidence: unsetRangeStyleValues refuses when a range patch matches the requested key/value but `owned(patch.range)` is false (patch extends outside the selection). The suite covers the analogous refusal for column, row and sheet layers ('should write an explicit value when a column/row/sheet style sets decimals') and conflict cases for patches, but never the case of e.g. a dp:1/nf:'number' patch on A1:B1 with only A1 selected, where the correct outcome is an explicit dp write and B1 keeping its inherited decimals. That branch — the one that protects neighbours outside the selection from losing formatting — is unexercised.

samples.summary: Spill-field preservation is only tested through `setStyle`; the clear-formatting path that also calls `compactCell` is untested
samples.evidence: compactCell now copies spillRows/spillCols/spillAnchor/spillBlocked, which fixes every caller — including `clearCellStylesInRange` (sheet.ts:2007, `compactCell(existing)` with no style), used by clear-formatting. The new tests in test/model/style-mutation.test.ts only drive `sheet.setStyle`; no test clears formatting over a spill anchor/ghost and asserts the spill metadata survives. Nothing would catch a regression on that caller.

samples.summary: Multi-range selections (`this.ranges.length > 1`) are never exercised through `changeDecimals`/`unsetRangeStyleValues`
samples.evidence: selectionTargets returns `this.ranges` and every loop in unsetRangeStyleValues iterates all targets (including the `visited` de-duplication across overlapping targets). Every case in decimals.test.ts uses selectStart/selectEnd, selectColumn(Range), selectRow or selectAllCells — a single range. So the multi-target paths (per-target column/row filters, cross-target visited de-dup, patch containment against any target) run only with one range in tests.
searchedFor: grep selectStart/selectEnd/selectColumnRange usage in the new test file

samples.summary: `unsetRangeStyleValues` early return for an empty/all-undefined request is untested
samples.evidence: unsetRangeStyleValues returns false when the filtered entries list is empty (sheet.ts:4338). It is a public async method, but no test calls it directly — all coverage is via changeDecimals, which always passes at least `{dp}`. The documented contract 'returns false, having written nothing' for an empty request is unasserted.
searchedFor: grep unsetRangeStyleValues in packages/sheets (src only hits)

samples.summary: The view-level increase/decrease delegation change has no test
samples.evidence: Spreadsheet.increaseDecimals/decreaseDecimals were rewritten to call `sheet.changeDecimals(±1)`. Grepping increaseDecimals/decreaseDecimals across packages/sheets finds only spreadsheet.ts — no test in test/view/* invokes them, so nothing pins that the sign is passed correctly (a swapped delta would still pass the whole model-level suite in decimals.test.ts). Pre-existing gap, but the changed lines are the only place the sign is chosen.
